import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
i2,o2=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']
# where do input and output differ?
diffs=[(r,c,i2[r][c],o2[r][c]) for r in range(len(i2)) for c in range(len(i2[0])) if i2[r][c]!=o2[r][c]]
rows=sorted(set(r for r,_,_,_ in diffs))
print("rows changed:",rows)
print("colors used:",sorted(set(v for row in i2 for v in row)), sorted(set(v for row in o2 for v in row)))
# top pattern rows 0-3 zeros, bottom rows 10-13
for r in rows:
    zi=[c for c,v in enumerate(i2[r]) if v!=6]
    zo=[c for c,v in enumerate(o2[r]) if v!=6]
    print(r, "in:",zi)
    print(r, "out:",zo)
print("ref rows:")
for r in range(4):
    print(r,[c for c,v in enumerate(i2[r]) if v!=6])
